sn47.30:1.2: Now on that occasion the householder Manadinna was sick, afflicted, gravely ill.
sn47.30:1.3: Then the householder Manadinna addressed a man thus:
sn47.30:1.5: “I am not bearing up, venerable sir, I am not getting better. Strong painful feelings are increasing in me, not subsiding, and their increase, not their subsiding, is to be discerned.
sn47.30:1.6: But, venerable sir, when I am being touched by such painful feeling, I dwell contemplating the body in the body … feelings in feelings …
sn47.30:1.9: phenomena in phenomena, ardent, clearly comprehending, mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world.
sn47.30:1.10: And as to these five lower fetters taught by the Blessed One, I do not see any of these unabandoned in myself.”
sn47.30:1.11: “It is a gain for you, householder! It is well gained by you, householder!
sn47.30:1.12: You have declared, householder, the fruit of nonreturning.”
